name: 16 AWG power pair
notes: Two copper conductors, V+ and GND, cut to the length a feed gives.

vplus.src: AWG 16: d = 0.127 mm x 92^((36 - 16)/39) = 1.291 mm, A = pi d^2/4; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_wire_gauge
